answer: Perishable evidence: every work unit must quote a reading that exists only in that moment, a plume drifting over the dune at that hour rather than one predicted in advance. Because nothing can be stockpiled, a farm must keep each mask awake and aimed at live state every round, paying attention per head forever, while a pre-written answer is a forged opal whose timestamp is stale and simply expires unpaid. Honest agents pay that cost once, per real task.
